authority.alpha_prerequisite: Establish a source-backed engineering evidence foundation for reproducible builds, release-equivalent diagnostics, causal tracing, deterministic failure reproduction, profiling, benchmark science, and optimization without making research a second runtime or release authority.

current_behavior: The engine data-flow owner already defines release-equivalent diagnostic mode, bounded observability, metric and latency contracts, and sanitized captures, while the roadmap names H-05 and Gate J implementation packages. The checkout has tracing at selected boundaries and a pinned Rust/DataFusion workspace, but it has no Cargo diagnostic profile, OpenTelemetry bridge, closed runtime metric implementation, unified release-evidence runner, fixed-hardware benchmark implementation, release assembly tooling, or one focused source-backed engineering guide that tells future packages which build, debugging, tracing, failure-reproduction, profiling, and optimization techniques to apply or reject. Relevant primary-source conclusions are currently distributed across external specifications and broader repository research.
target_behavior: Create one bounded, repository-indexed research record that translates current primary-source practice into RRFlow-specific implementation guidance: separate correctness, diagnostic, fault, profiler, benchmark, and release modes; bind every artifact to reproducible build identity and provenance; preserve RrdEngine as durable authority while projecting bounded causal signals; define deterministic failure artifacts and a layered test matrix; choose symptom-specific native profilers; require distribution-aware benchmark evidence; and provide an adopt/defer/reject decision matrix plus package handoff to the existing roadmap. The record must cite current primary sources, distinguish researched evidence from RRFlow recommendations, and explicitly remain subordinate to architecture, roadmap, POA&M, and measured evidence owners.
unchanged_behavior: README.md remains product identity and current-status owner; the objective owns outcomes; the roadmap owns dependency order and completion evidence; the POA&M owns verified gap status; engine-data-flow owns the accepted observability and diagnostic contract.

No Rust code, Cargo profile, dependency, feature, API, schema, generated binding, SDK, workflow, fixture, executable, telemetry signal, persistence format, benchmark result, release artifact, product version, or installed behavior changes.

Research does not mark C-07, D-01, H-05, J-02, J-04, J-05, a POA&M item, or alpha readiness complete and does not turn diagnostic output, logs, traces, metrics, profiles, or benchmark harness state into engine authority.
Exploratory reasoning remains adaptive under ADR-0002; only governed durable effects cross the RrdEngine boundary, and future generators remain replaceable projections from one semantic owner.

implementation_changes.action: Create a comprehensive primary-source research artifact that makes future build, debug, trace, fault-reproduction, profiling, benchmark, and optimization choices reviewable while deferring accepted semantics and completion to their current owners.
implementation_changes.failure_semantics: Stop if the record duplicates the architecture or roadmap, prescribes a schema of thought, treats telemetry as state, claims unmeasured performance or completion, adopts an external source tree, or leaves recommendations uncited and unbounded.

implementation_changes.action: Link the new bounded research record from the owning research index and update the index review date without copying its body.
implementation_changes.failure_semantics: Stop if the index absorbs implementation detail or becomes product, architecture, planning, or evidence authority.

evidence_changes.action: Create the linked package journal with exact baseline, full reads, changed paths, primary-source method, commands/results, surfaced failures, omissions, remaining gaps, and explicit no-status-change statement.
Regenerate the nearest journal index so the new package receipt is discoverable.

research.reason: The package exists to compare current RRFlow boundaries with current language, telemetry, reliability, profiling, benchmarking, and supply-chain practice. Primary specifications and project documentation are required to separate portable semantics from tool-specific mechanisms and to avoid inventing unsupported performance or diagnostic claims.

sources.title: Cargo Book: Profiles
sources.retained_behavior: Use root-owned custom profiles and explicit optimization/debug/LTO/codegen settings to create release-derived diagnostic and benchmark modes.
sources.rejected_assumption: A debug build or an implicitly configured local profile can represent shipped behavior or release latency.

sources.title: rustc book: Remap source paths
sources.retained_behavior: Normalize compiler-emitted build paths where supported and verify the resulting artifacts on every target.
sources.rejected_assumption: Path remapping alone makes every linker, symbol, generated file, and platform artifact reproducible or secret-free.

sources.title: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH specification
sources.retained_behavior: Derive embedded build timestamps from a deterministic source-owned epoch and clamp archive metadata.
sources.rejected_assumption: A wall-clock build timestamp is a reliable source identity or that timestamp normalization proves reproducibility.

sources.title: SLSA 1.2 build provenance
sources.retained_behavior: Bind outputs to source, resolved inputs, build definition, builder, invocation, and useful diagnostic byproducts by digest.
sources.rejected_assumption: A checksum or provenance envelope proves the artifact is correct, secure, performant, or qualified.

sources.title: OpenTelemetry tracing API
sources.retained_behavior: Model bounded operations as spans with stable names, causal context, events, links, and explicit terminal error status.
sources.rejected_assumption: An exported or sampled span is durable engine evidence or permission for an effect.

sources.title: W3C Trace Context
sources.retained_behavior: Validate and propagate traceparent/tracestate interoperably with explicit privacy and trust-boundary handling.
sources.rejected_assumption: Incoming trace context is trusted identity, authorization, or a safe carrier for personal or secret data.

sources.title: OpenTelemetry metrics data model
sources.retained_behavior: Use aggregatable sums, gauges, and histograms with declared temporality and optional trace exemplars.
sources.rejected_assumption: Per-request identifiers belong in metric attributes or precomputed averages preserve tail behavior.

sources.title: OpenTelemetry error handling
sources.retained_behavior: Make telemetry fail independently, expose bounded self-diagnostics, and prefer signal loss over application semantic change.
sources.rejected_assumption: Exporter success can establish operation success or exporter failure may block, roll back, or crash engine work.

sources.title: Tokio: Getting started with Tracing
sources.retained_behavior: Use structured spans and events to preserve async causality and install subscribers at executable composition roots.
sources.rejected_assumption: Unstructured interleaved log lines or a subscriber hidden in a library provide a coherent causal path.

sources.title: Rust standard library backtrace module
sources.retained_behavior: Capture backtraces only in explicitly enabled diagnostic paths and retain matching debug information for symbolization.
sources.rejected_assumption: Backtraces are cheap, complete, portable, or reliable enough to replace typed failure coordinates.

sources.title: Miri
sources.retained_behavior: Run bounded interpreter-compatible tests to expose undefined behavior and selected weak-memory effects.
sources.rejected_assumption: One Miri execution covers native FFI, all schedules, all platforms, or all Rust correctness properties.

sources.title: Loom concurrency testing
sources.retained_behavior: Model small concurrency primitives with deterministic interleaving exploration and retained failing seeds/configuration.
sources.rejected_assumption: Loom sees synchronization not routed through its replacement types or scales to the entire engine state space.

sources.title: Rust compiler sanitizer support
sources.retained_behavior: Use target-specific sanitizer lanes alongside tests, fuzzing, Miri, and native execution with symbolized reports.
sources.rejected_assumption: Sanitizers are zero-overhead production modes, universally supported, or complete proof of memory and concurrency safety.

sources.title: FoundationDB simulation and testing
sources.retained_behavior: Combine deterministic seeded failure simulation, live performance testing, and hardware failure tests rather than relying on one lane.
sources.rejected_assumption: Compilation, unit tests, simulation alone, or a mock filesystem qualifies crash and recovery behavior.

sources.title: Prometheus instrumentation practices
sources.retained_behavior: Measure traffic, errors, latency, saturation, queues, caches, and resource use with aggressively bounded label sets.
sources.rejected_assumption: Unbounded identifiers and content are safe labels or that more telemetry is automatically more useful.

sources.title: HdrHistogram
sources.retained_behavior: Retain raw high-dynamic-range latency distributions and prevent or explicitly correct coordinated omission.
sources.rejected_assumption: Averages, a few percentiles, or closed-loop samples faithfully represent latency during stalls.

sources.title: Apache DataFusion testing guide
sources.retained_behavior: Start with the smallest oracle, widen to SQL/integration coverage, and run repeatable benchmarks against retained identical data.
sources.rejected_assumption: A microbenchmark or a newly generated dataset proves end-to-end query improvement.

sources.title: Criterion BenchmarkGroup
sources.retained_behavior: Declare measurement time, sample size, confidence, significance, throughput, and practical noise thresholds for microbenchmarks.
sources.rejected_assumption: Statistical significance alone means a change is operationally meaningful or release-acceptable.

sources.title: Google SRE: Monitoring distributed systems
sources.retained_behavior: Correlate latency, traffic, errors, and saturation and keep automated signals simple enough to produce an actionable investigation.
sources.rejected_assumption: One dashboard, mean latency, or an opaque anomaly detector establishes causality.

sources.title: The Tail at Scale
sources.retained_behavior: Treat tail latency and utilization-sensitive stragglers as first-class end-to-end behavior.
sources.rejected_assumption: Median latency or isolated component speed predicts interactive system responsiveness.

sources.title: rustc profile-guided optimization
sources.retained_behavior: Consider PGO only after representative, versioned workloads and stable build/benchmark evidence exist.
sources.rejected_assumption: PGO is a free build flag or profiles gathered from arbitrary workloads generalize to the shipped product.

sources.title: Valgrind Cachegrind manual
sources.retained_behavior: Use reproducible instruction counts to complement noisy elapsed-time and sampling profiles for bounded CPU investigations.
sources.rejected_assumption: Simulated cache behavior exactly models modern target hardware or instruction reduction guarantees latency reduction.

sources.title: Microsoft Windows Performance Toolkit
sources.retained_behavior: Capture native Windows CPU, disk, memory, scheduling, and application events with WPR and inspect them with WPA.
sources.rejected_assumption: Linux profiling results explain native Windows behavior or cross-compilation supplies native runtime evidence.

sources.title: Apple recording performance data
sources.retained_behavior: Use bounded signpost intervals and native Instruments captures to correlate RRFlow operations on Apple targets.
sources.rejected_assumption: Portable spans alone expose every scheduler, allocation, I/O, or platform-specific performance cause.

runtime_trace.reason: The research maps future diagnostic projections to the already accepted one-causal-chain architecture; it changes no span, event, context propagation, durable trace, engine operation, or exporter behavior.

resource_evidence.reason: The research specifies how future packages should collect CPU, wall time, allocation, RSS, disk, copy/decode, queue, telemetry-overhead, and raw latency distributions, while making no measurement or acceptance claim in this package.

debugging_evidence.reason: The research defines release-equivalent diagnostic builds, typed failure coordinates, deterministic seed/schedule artifacts, fuzz/sanitizer/concurrency lanes, capture contents, and symptom-to-profiler selection for future implementation packages.

first_failure_oracle: No focused record in docs/research links reproducible build identity, release-equivalent diagnostics, causal telemetry, deterministic failures, native profilers, benchmark science, and optimization decisions to RRFlow's current implementation boundaries.
The workspace root has no Cargo profile declarations, while the architecture requires distinct release, diagnostic, fault, benchmark, and runtime-analysis modes without semantic feature drift.
Current tracing is present at selected adapter, storage, and engine boundaries, but no OpenTelemetry dependency, governed exporter bridge, or implemented closed metric catalogue exists.
Only the rrflowKV fuzz package currently exposes fuzz targets, and no shared release-evidence runner or deterministic whole-engine fault artifact contract exists.
The J-02/J-04/J-05 planned release-evidence, comparison, assembly, verification, and distribution paths are absent, so research must define prerequisites without pretending they are implemented.

stop_conditions: The research creates or overrides product, architecture, roadmap, POA&M, operation-catalogue, lifecycle, or evidence authority, or constrains private reasoning into a closed schema.

A recommendation lets diagnostic configuration change engine semantics, lets telemetry establish durable success or authorization, or makes an exporter, profiler, hosted service, provider, or external database a default prerequisite.

Build guidance claims reproducibility without independent artifact comparison, hides native-target limitations, changes the frozen 1.0.0 version, or implies provenance/signing proves runtime qualification.
Benchmark guidance accepts means, coordinated omission, different inputs/configuration, unpinned hardware/software, unreported failures, or statistical significance without a practical threshold.

The package claims a gate complete, reports an unexecuted tool or measurement as evidence, copies an external implementation surface, changes an undeclared path, or leaves navigation/inventory/documentation drift.
roadmap_status_change: None. This package supplies supporting primary-source research and a future implementation handoff only; all roadmap checkboxes, POA&M statuses, objective outcomes, product version, release state, and promotion state remain unchanged.
